task: Research/catalog only; no source repository or website was modified.

method.selection: Editorial ranking prioritizing usefulness, up-to-date activity, simplicity, functional fit, accessibility potential, and compatibility with GitHub Pages. Rankings are not measurements.
method.direct_topic_scope: github_topic_frontend=true indicates verified explicit topic tagging; false resources are contextual compatible additions from related GitHub projects.
method.metadata_snapshot: 2026-11-16; GitHub star counts and push timestamps change over time.
method.license_interpretation: license_spdx is GitHub API metadata, not an independent license audit. NOASSERTION is stored as null in normalized license_spdx and retained in github_license_spdx_raw.
verification_limits: No source code built or executed
No actual Lighthouse or axe audits conducted
Package transitive dependency graph and current release pin not exhaustively verified
Do not infer license permissions from this file alone
method.unknowns: Unverified facts are null; evaluative text is labeled as assessment and must not be treated as lab results.

served_artifacts: static JSON and other static files
unsupported_examples: Server action or internal dynamic API routes
On-host database or user authentication service
hosting_constraints.external_services_possible: Browser-side requests to independently hosted APIs are possible when CORS, authentication and secrets are handled correctly.
hosting_constraints.base_path_requirement: Project-page assets and links must respect /REPOSITORY/; root site and custom root domain generally use /.

deployment_modes.uncompiled: Publish static files from a branch or workflow
deployment_modes.compiled: Use GitHub Actions to install, build and upload generated output only

seo_considerations: Use unique title and meta description per page
Set canonical URLs correctly for Pages path
Prefer static-rendered pages for content discoverability
Check Open Graph previews and structured data
accessibility_minimum: Appropriate labels, names and image alternatives
Test with axe and manual keyboard checks

recommended_frontend_stack.primary: HTML5 + precompiled Bulma CSS + custom CSS + vanilla JavaScript + individual Lucide SVG icons
recommended_frontend_stack.goal: Low-dependency, responsive, accessible static website without build step.
runtime_dependencies: Bulma CSS (vendor a pinned stable release)
optional_runtime_dependencies: KittyGiraudel/a11y-dialog if accessible modals are required
nolimits4web/swiper only if touch carousels are required
recommended_frontend_stack.asset_strategy: Prefer vendored version-pinned CSS/JS and only selected SVGs for determinism; verify version-specific licenses and integrity.
recommended_frontend_stack.publishing_strategy: Commit/publish static HTML/CSS/JS. Root index.html and correct /REPOSITORY/ relative assets for project sites.
why: Avoids shipping a large app framework for brochure/content use cases

alternatives.situation: Content-rich site with component templates and islands

conditional_static_exports.name: vercel/next.js
conditional_static_exports.description: React application framework with conditional static export.
conditional_static_exports.configuration: Set output: export; configure basePath/assetPrefix as needed; ensure every dynamic route can be precomputed.
conditional_static_exports.build_process: next build generates out/ static export; deploy that directory.
conditional_static_exports.deployment_notes: Ship only generated/static browser files; do not assume GitHub Pages runs Node.js or API servers.
practical_applications: Large React content applications with no server-only features
limitations: No server actions, runtime route handlers, cookies, ISR or image optimizer default server runtime on Pages
More complex than needed for simple site

quality_review.accessibility: Component accessibility is author responsibility.

conditional_static_exports.name: nuxt/nuxt

conditional_static_exports.configuration: Use static generation (nuxi generate) and ensure all routes/data can be pre-rendered; set deploy base URL.

quality_review.accessibility: Vue UI must be accessible.

conditional_static_exports.name: sveltejs/kit
conditional_static_exports.description: Svelte app framework with static adapter.
conditional_static_exports.configuration: Prerender routes and set correct base paths; enable SPA fallback only after evaluating Pages 404 behavior.
conditional_static_exports.build_process: Build static output (commonly build/ as configured by adapter); deploy that folder.
conditional_static_exports.deployment_notes: Ship only generated/static browser files; do not assume GitHub Pages runs Node.js or API servers.
limitations: Endpoints needing runtime SSR cannot run on Pages
Routing fallback can be unreliable without planned 404 strategy

quality_review.performance: Framework compilation; performance depends on app.

compatibility_conflicts.issue: Global resets, element and component class names can conflict. Choose one primary CSS framework.
Combining complete styling systems may produce inconsistent defaults and larger CSS.
Both assume Tailwind workflows and can duplicate component styling and themes.
Competing Tailwind components may bind to same controls; configure only one behavior owner.
Separate component runtimes inflate bundles; do not mix without a defined isolation boundary.
Both may mutate the same DOM subtree; divide responsibility clearly.
Do not initialize two modal controllers on one dialog; choose a single implementation.
Multiple carousels add redundant CSS/JS and may conflict in gesture handling.
Bootstrap default main README currently documents v6 alpha; pin stable v5 release for production.
Tailwind v4 build and plugin configuration differ from v3; verify all component versions.
Missing vite.config base=/REPOSITORY/ yields broken assets on project URLs.
Server actions, ISR, cookies and runtime dynamic routes cannot execute in static output.
Dynamic HTML response routes require external server; Pages can host static fragments only.
Unknown routes may return 404; prefer prerendered routes or a carefully tested fallback.
Disable conflicting formatting rules and use ESLint for semantics, Prettier for formatting.
